Definition: a primary verb; probably originally, to "puff" or blow, i.e. to swell up; but only used in the implied sense, to germinate or grow (sprout, produce), literally or figuratively:--spring (up).
BiblicalUsage: Phyo means to spring up, to grow. Seed on good ground springs up and bears fruit a hundredfold in Luke 8:8, but a root of bitterness can spring up too, and defile many, in Hebrews 12:15.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what grows in me will show, whether it is fruit or bitterness.
